description_en: Instructs a specified agent instance to immediately play back a text message, with support for interrupt settings
description_zh: 让指定智能体实例立即播报文本消息，支持打断设置
name: SendAIAgentSpeech

parameters.help_en:
Agent instance ID.

The InstanceId is the unique ID returned after successfully starting an agent instance. For details about starting an agent instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.help_zh:
智能体实例ID。

InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The text content to be played back. The supported input format varies based on the Type parameter. The length cannot exceed 1024 characters
parameters.help_zh: 需要播报的文本内容。根据不同Type支持不同的输入类型。长度不超过1024
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the broadcast can interrupt the ongoing speech. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 这条主动播报是否能打断当前语音。默认值：true
parameters.name: enable_interrupt

parameters.help_en:
Input type. Valid values:

Text: Input is plain text.

AudioUrl: Input is an audio URL.

Default value: Text
parameters.help_zh:
输入类型，可选：

Text：传入类型文本

AudioUrl：传入类型为音频链接

默认Text
parameters.name: type
